lastCompletedStory.title: Sidecar merge-watch state: poll PR for MERGED then run post-merge + narrate

nextStoryContext: US-007 added src/release/merge-watch.ts: runMergeWatch(opts) with injectable GhPollFn and PostMergeFn. Poll loop: state==MERGED -> runPostMerge + narrate; state==CLOSED -> narrate closed-not-merged + stop; OPEN+BLOCKED -> narrate CI red + stop; null (gh error) -> silent retry; OPEN+other -> keep polling; maxPolls exhausted -> narrate timeout + stop. Wired into RunSidecarLoopOptions.runMergeWatchFn (idle-tick call in runSidecarLoop) and SidecarOptions.runMergeWatchFn (production: reads .claude/.cam-merge-watch.json, only under ci-gated mode; immediate leaves field absent = inert). The MERGE_WATCH_FILENAME constant is '.cam-merge-watch.json'. The orchestrator (cam-ship.md Step 7 ci-gated) is expected to write this file with { prNumber, mergedBranch } before handing off to the sidecar. Also added gh to knip.json ignoreBinaries. 1639 tests all pass.

officialDocsValidated.summary: gh pr view --json state,mergeStateStatus confirmed. PullRequest.state values: OPEN, MERGED, CLOSED. MergeStateStatus values: BLOCKED (CI failing/admin enforced), CLEAN, CONFLICTING, DRAFT, BEHIND, UNKNOWN. No UNSTABLE or MERGED in MergeStateStatus (MERGED is a PullRequest.state). Implementation correctly handles all cases: BLOCKED -> ci-red, MERGED state -> post-merge, CLOSED state -> closed-not-merged, all others -> keep polling.
